dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product asks for exactly one choice among a few options shown at once, selected and not, enabled and disabled, and marks the options of a question whose answer was refused.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a radio button reads: the least height an option takes in layout (option), the round state layer (container), the ring (its size, its unselected stroke, and the share of its radius the stroke takes when selected), the fill inside the selected ring (its inset and opacity), the label style and gap, and for each condition (unselected, selected and their error- forms) the container / ring / fill / label colors in each state.
rules: Radio buttons come in groups of two or more with one selected; for a single yes/no choice use a checkbox or a switch.
Hover, focus and press show on the container (the round layer behind the ring), never on the ring.
An unselected ring must stay visible (sys.color.outline is at least 3:1).

In the default system the ring alone carries the selected condition at 3:1 against the surface (sys.color.primary is held to 4.5:1 on every surface); the translucent fill is never counted for that. The fill is a part of the mark all the same: it is held 3:1 against the ring it meets, or against the gap where fill.inset leaves one (WCAG 1.4.11), in every enabled state and on every surface role. A layer may restyle both freely.
The selected stroke grows inward: the ring's outer diameter never changes with the condition.
The fill never grows or shrinks on its own: it covers what the ring leaves inside it, less fill.inset, and only its color changes with the condition.

The condition is chosen by the props and by the group: error, or a radio group or a field group in error, prefixes the condition (error-unselected, error-selected). Never pick a condition by hand, and never mark one option of a group alone.
An error form recolors the ring and the fill and nothing else; the error is the group's, said by the group's error text and its invalid state. The error color is for errors alone.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.
Each condition's state-layer.color is the color hover, focus and press mix into its container; it aliases that condition's ring color.

min-height.$description: The least height one option takes in layout, the container centered in it. At the target size, options stacked with no space between them keep whole targets that do not overlap; a layer may lower it, accepting shared target area, or raise it.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product stacks its options at the full target height; another packs them tighter in a dense form and accepts that neighbouring targets overlap.

size.$description: The round state layer behind the ring, 40; the 48 target reaches 4 beyond it on each side.
The outer diameter of the ring, the same in both conditions, 20.

width.$description: The stroke of the unselected ring, drawn inside its outer diameter. It is also the thinnest the selected ring's stroke can be.

selected-width-share.$description: The stroke of the selected ring, as a share of the ring's radius, drawn inward from the outer diameter: 0 keeps ring.width, 1 is a stroke as wide as the radius (a solid disc). A share narrower than ring.width draws ring.width.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product marks the chosen option by how heavy its ring becomes (a thin line when unselected, a thick band or a solid disc when selected), apart from its color, so that the selection does not rest on color alone.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: Material keeps the selected ring's 2 stroke (2 of the 10 radius) and marks the selection with the dot.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product fills the inside of the chosen option's ring (a soft tint, an opaque dot with a gap, or a light center), apart from the ring itself.

inset.$description: How far the fill's edge sits inside the ring's inner edge, wherever the stroke is at that moment. 0 fills the whole disc left inside the ring; a larger inset leaves a gap between ring and fill and turns the fill into a dot.

opacity.$description: The opacity the fill is drawn at, applied to the fill color of the condition and state. The fill lies inside the ring, never under it, so a translucent ring (disabled) never shows the fill through it. Where the fill meets the ring (fill.inset 0), the fill as drawn is held 3:1 against the ring in every enabled state, on every surface role (WCAG 1.4.11). The default system draws it as the selected layer, the step a checked menu row, a selected list option and the tonal tabs' indicator take: light enough that the fill stands 3:1 apart from the ring it meets (3.17:1 at the least, the focused error form on surface-container-highest in light), where a half did not (1.91:1). A design system that draws an opaque dot sets this token to 1.

gap.$description: From the container to the label. With the 40 container it starts the label where the 48 target ends.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The state layer is invisible at rest; hover, focus and press mix into it.

color.$description: The fill's color while unselected, where the selection motion starts and ends it: none in the default system, so an unselected radio button shows no fill.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: An unselected radio button shows no fill.
The state layer is invisible at rest; hover, focus and press mix into it.

color.$description: The fill inside the selected ring, drawn at fill.opacity.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The state layer is invisible at rest; hover, focus and press mix into it.

color.$description: The ring of an unselected option in error: the error role, as an error checkbox's outline. At least 3:1 on every surface (the build holds the role to 4.5:1).
The fill while unselected and in error: none in the default system, as out of error.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: An unselected radio button shows no fill.

color.$description: The label keeps naming the option in error: the error is the set's, and its words are below the set.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The state layer is invisible at rest; hover, focus and press mix into it.

color.$description: The ring of a selected option in error: the error role, as an error checkbox's box. The stroke is as heavy as out of error, so the selection is still told by weight.
The fill inside the selected ring in error, drawn at fill.opacity: the ring's color, as out of error.
The label keeps naming the option in error: the error is the set's, and its words are below the set.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

selection-duration.$description: How long the ring's stroke takes to thicken or thin, and the ring and fill to change color (the fill from none to its color and back), when the selection changes.
